automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Topic News Collector

cutoff_window.policy: Include only public sources published or visibly updated within the last two days relative to the run time. Exclude missing, ambiguous, future-dated, stale, or boundary-only dates.

federation_boundary.collector_boundary_note: Items below retain local practice implications and routing notes only. Broad ecosystem entity facts are marked upstream-owned.

qualifying_updates.title: GitHub Copilot app guidance packages repository instructions, skills, agents, and MCP servers as codebase context
qualifying_updates.summary: GitHub published practice guidance for tailoring Copilot with repository custom instructions, path-specific instruction files, project-level agent skills, custom agents, and MCP servers such as Playwright for browser verification.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: This is a direct practice source for durable instructions, repeatable skill packaging, custom agent roles, and governed tool access. It maps naturally to local coverage for prompt-and-instructions, agent-workflows, retrieval-and-tools, verification-and-evals, and adoption operating agreements.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_notes: During ingest, compare against local leaves for durable instructions, portable skills/runbooks, custom agents, progressive MCP discovery, and verification via browser tooling. Keep product-specific Copilot background upstream-owned.

qualifying_updates.title: GitHub Copilot managed settings add user attribution and configurable telemetry capture classes
qualifying_updates.summary: GitHub added managed-settings telemetry controls that can attribute Copilot activity to a user without collecting prompts, responses, or tool content by default, with separate capture classes for prompts, responses, tool arguments, tool output, and policy details.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: This is practice-level governance evidence for audit logging, privacy boundaries, tool-call evidence, policy capture, and approved collection endpoints in coding-agent environments.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_notes: Potentially update governance leaves for telemetry minimization and audit evidence. Preserve the warning that prompt, tool, command, file, and path capture can expose sensitive local content.

qualifying_updates.title: GitHub Copilot managed settings can fail closed when policy freshness cannot be confirmed
qualifying_updates.summary: GitHub added a forceRemoteSettingsRefresh managed setting so supported Copilot clients retrieve current policy at startup, and added minimum client version enforcement for governance-focused settings such as sandbox.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: This supports local practice around stale-policy risk, fail-closed agent operation, sandbox enforcement, client-version gates, and enterprise-managed permission baselines.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_notes: Consider local synthesis under destructive-command controls, execution-edge authorization, agent environment readiness, and governance controls for agents.

qualifying_updates.title: GitHub Code Quality finding dismissals and reopenings become audit-log events
qualifying_updates.summary: GitHub added organization and enterprise audit-log events for manual dismissals and reopenings of Code Quality findings, including actor, time, repository, rule, affected finding identifiers, and count.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: This is local-practice evidence for auditability of AI-assisted quality decisions, manual override tracking, and review-governance evidence packages.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_notes: Ingest as an audit-trail pattern, not a product encyclopedia update. Check whether local leaves already cover finding dismissal evidence.

qualifying_updates.title: GitHub Code scanning AI Scan metrics expose pull-request AI-scan effectiveness and autofix response
qualifying_updates.summary: GitHub added security-overview metrics for AI Scan pull-request findings, remediation rate, repositories generating findings, reporting-period trends, and developer use of autofix suggestions.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: The update is practice evidence for rollout metrics, AI security-review effectiveness, remediation tracking, and investment decisions without reviewing every individual pull request.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_notes: Potential fit for AI-assisted security repair gates, lifecycle AI review gates, and code-review eval/rubric coverage.

qualifying_updates.title: GitHub push attribution records authenticated pusher identity independent of author and committer metadata
qualifying_updates.summary: GitHub added durable per-commit pusher identity and a repository ruleset condition requiring the committer to match the pusher, reducing commit identity spoofing risk.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: This is local governance evidence for commit-level AI governance, delegated authority, review policy enforcement, and auditability when humans and agents both contribute code.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_notes: During ingest, connect to commit-level AI governance and agent identity leaves. Do not restate broad GitHub feature details beyond the practice implication.

qualifying_updates.title: GitHub secret scanning blocks Anthropic keys by default through push protection
qualifying_updates.summary: GitHub expanded secret scanning to detect Anthropic, Salesforce, and Cloudsmith secret types, with Anthropic service and user API keys included in push protection by default.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: This is practice evidence for package and agent supply-chain controls, credential leak prevention in agent-authored commits, and default-blocking expectations for AI provider keys.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_notes: Useful for sensitive-data and supply-chain controls. Treat provider/detector specifics as upstream-owned except where local practice needs the push-protection control.

qualifying_updates.title: GitHub Dependabot alerts now distinguish withdrawn advisories through webhooks and HTTP 410 responses
qualifying_updates.summary: GitHub added a withdrawn action to the dependabot_alert webhook and returns 410 Gone for withdrawn alerts so integrations can distinguish withdrawn advisories from never-existing alerts.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: This affects source-ingest reconciliation and package-risk workflows: downstream security dashboards and agent-maintained tickets should mark withdrawals explicitly rather than silently erasing evidence.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_notes: Consider source-reconciliation coverage for withdrawn or retracted evidence. Keep broad Dependabot product background upstream-owned.

qualifying_updates.title: GitHub organization-level private registries can now be configured with anonymous authentication for Dependabot
qualifying_updates.summary: GitHub added Anonymous as an authentication method for organization-level private registries that Dependabot can reach without credentials, such as internal mirrors with anonymous reads.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: This is practice evidence for dependency update agents, egress allowlists, package-install risk, and credential minimization when automation needs registry access.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_notes: Potentially synthesize into sensitive-data/supply-chain controls and governed tool access, emphasizing least-credential registry access.

qualifying_updates.title: GitHub budgets and alerts page adds searchable and filterable budget lists
qualifying_updates.summary: GitHub added search and filters for budgets by scope, product, SKU, and, in enterprises and organizations, user.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: This is local adoption evidence for cost governance as coding-agent usage scales across users, organizations, products, and billable usage items.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_notes: If ingested, frame as agent cost telemetry and operating-model ownership rather than as a general billing UI update.

qualifying_updates.title: Gemini 4 Argon availability in GitHub Copilot includes administrator model-policy controls
qualifying_updates.summary: GitHub announced Gemini 4 Argon availability in Copilot surfaces and noted that Copilot Business and Enterprise administrators can manage access through model policy settings, with default model enablement behavior.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: The broad model and product release is upstream-owned, but the local practice implication is model access governance, automatic enablement review, usage-based billing awareness, and workflow compatibility checks when new coding models appear.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_notes: Route model/product facts upstream. Keep only local model-policy, default-enable, cost, and verification implications if ingested.

Potential high-signal ingest themes: durable repository context packaging, Copilot telemetry privacy controls, fail-closed managed settings, AI review audit events, AI Scan rollout metrics, commit pusher attribution, credential push protection for AI provider keys, Dependabot withdrawn-alert reconciliation, least-credential registry access, and user/SKU-level cost governance.
